subject: MAP alignment: target close date & procurement signature deadline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP (target close & procurement timeline)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

- Objective: get Redwood integrated for low-latency payments fraud scoring (pilot) and finalize enterprise contract for production by Q4.
- Agreed target close date: Dec 10, 2026 (customerrequested). Need procurement signature by Dec 17 to meet onboarding kickoff.
- Action: I've attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v1.docx) that outlines milestones, owners, and dependencies. Please review and flag any missing items.

Key milestones in the draft MAP:
1) Security review completion (FintechCo) — target Nov 30 — owner: FintechCo SecOps.
2) Pilot data access + onboarding (joint) — target Dec 8 — owner: FintechCo Eng + Redwood CS.
3) Commercial approval + exec sign-off — target Dec 10 — owner: FintechCo Head of Payments.
4) Procurement/Legal signature — target Dec 17 — owner: FintechCo Procurement.

Open dependencies: SOC 2 evidence (we provided last week), test data export format confirmation, and procurement SOW redlines.

Can you confirm the internal owners and whether the Dec 17 procurement signature is achievable? If there's a hard procurement deadline, please call it out so we can prioritize accordingly.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a version that includes any changes you request.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0198

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.docx

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@fintechco.com>

Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@fintechco.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (target close & procurement timeline)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the MAP. A few quick notes from our side: 

- High level OK on milestones; appreciated the callout for owners. I'll confirm SecOps owner (likely Priya) by Friday.
- Procurement timeline: our internal target to have legal sign off is Dec 12, but procurement processes usually take until Dec 20 for physical signature and bookkeeping. Can you confirm whether Dec 20 would still work for your onboarding schedule?
- We do need the SOW redlines before procurement can move; I've attached the procurement checklist as a reference.

Also: our VP of Payments (Jordan) is out next week but asked to be looped for the commercial approval step — I expect his review by Dec 9.

Samantha

Head of Partnerships | FintechCo
samantha.liu@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (target close & procurement timeline)

Thanks Samantha — that timeline makes sense and good to know Jordan can sign off by Dec 9. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- Rishi is looping in legal on the SOW redlines. Rishi — can you confirm we can turn around a clean SOW for procurement within 3 business days of receiving FintechCo's redlines?
- Camila (solutions engineer) — can you confirm pilot onboarding can still target Dec 8 if procurement signs on Dec 17 vs Dec 20? The key is access to test data and a short kickoff window.

If procurement needs until Dec 20 for signature, the risk is pushing onboarding by ~1 week (likely Dec 20–27). We can mitigate by starting integration work that does not require production data (model validation, config). I've attached an updated MAP with tentative date adjustments for a Dec 20 signature as a backup.

Next steps: please reply with: (1) confirmation of procurement latest-sign-date (Dec 17 vs Dec 20), (2) SOW redline ETA, (3) SecOps owner name. I'll consolidate into the MAP and share a final version.

Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.docx (updated backup dates), SOW_draft.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: MAP owners + SOW turnaround

Marissa/Camila/Rishi — quick internal sync after Samantha's note.

- Rishi: confirmed — legal can prioritize redlines and deliver a clean SOW within 48–72 hours of receiving FintechCo's comments. We should prepare a clean markup template to accelerate.
- Camila: if procurement signs Dec 20, pilot kickoff can still aim for Dec 15 for non-prod work; full production onboarding will shift ~1 week. We can parallelize config and model calibration work so Jordan’s team sees progress pre-signature.
- I’ll prepare a one-page exec summary for Jordan to speed commercial approval (due Dec 9). Marissa, if you want it, I can have a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Recommend we set two formal deadlines in the MAP: 
1) Preferred timeline: procurement signature by Dec 17 -> pilot full onboarding week of Dec 13–17.
2) Backup timeline: procurement signature by Dec 20 -> pilot full onboarding week of Dec 20–24 with partial non-prod kickoff Dec 15.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: MAP alignment: target close date & procurement signature deadline

Marissa/Team — thanks for the updates and for giving the two timeline options. Confirming the procurement desk has penciled in Dec 20 for physical signature due to year-end accounting cutoffs; however, legal sign-off (e-sig ready) should be completed by Dec 12. That means: 

- Jordan will complete commercial approval by Dec 9 as planned.
- Procurement can accept an SOW and place the PO once legal provides the final redlines (aiming for Dec 12). Physical signature will be Dec 20.
- For go-live planning, we'd like Redwood to prioritize non-prod onboarding and model validation starting Dec 15, with production flip on Dec 21–22.

We’re aligned on the backup timeline you proposed. Please update the MAP to show: legal e-signature target Dec 12, procurement signature Dec 20, and pilot non-prod start Dec 15. Also include the one-page exec summary for Jordan — that will help speed his review.

Samantha
